passed_checks: The earlier over-45K admission lower bound is compatible with the later reported 50,000 admissions.

issues_detected.description: Clinical modalities are listed without an explicit account of sensitive elements or user-facing content and handling warnings.
issues_detected.recommendation: Identify sensitive data elements and provide appropriate handling or content warnings.

issues_detected.description: The dataset has a project URI but neither a recommended citation nor a DOI.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide a recommended dataset citation and, when available, a persistent release DOI.

semantic_insights: The record carefully distinguishes current admissions from future targets and admissions from unique patients.
The 1,000-image and 7,642-radiology-admission figures use different units; the record appropriately avoids presenting them as contradictory counts.
The GitHub project's MIT license is explicitly kept separate from the undocumented dataset reuse terms.
Root conformance declarations substantiate OMOP, DICOM, and WFDB use without inheriting conformance from component entries.
OHNLP is disclosed in a genuine data-transformation role: extracting and tokenizing clinical notes.
Scientific motivation, research objectives, named leadership, institutional affiliations, and the NIH award are consistently documented.
Future labeling, holdout validation, sampling, and privacy work are explicitly identified as plans rather than reported as completed procedures.
